name: Physics
summary: How cars move: the vehicle model, tyre grip and temperatures, air and track temperature, weather: clock, temperatures, rain, standing water, drying line and rubber (SimEnvironment); slopes, crests and banking from the track elevation. Tyre compounds are JSON in data/.
notes: Pure data, no nodes, deterministic. CarDamage (wave 3): damage from hits and kerbs, its effect on the car, repair times for the pits, and visual_parts() for the 3D car. Setups (wave 4): ride height and bottoming, ground effect, springs/dampers/ARB, camber, toe, diff, tyre pressures (hot pressure from temperature). SetupAdvisor picks a good setup per car and track from a point-mass lap.
